name: Daggerspine Scale
summary: Along Hillsbrad Foothills' southern shores, Daggerspine Scale comes from tough reptilian scales harvested from prowling Daggerspine naga. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks them to activate virulent brews in the Forsaken's ongoing plague experiments.

sections.title: Apothecary Research
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks reagents for its toxins, plagues, and concoctions. While refining the experimental Elixir of Agony, its apothecaries found that scales from the local Daggerspine naga react in a useful way. Combined with troll regenerative elixirs and murloc organs, the scales chemically activate dormant contaminating agents suspended in raw mixtures. Gathering them means hunting along the rocky coastline east of Southshore, near both the vicious naga tribe and Alliance forces. The apothecaries need these scales for their research.

faq.q: What are Daggerspine Scales used for?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill gathers Daggerspine Scales for research into the Elixir of Agony. Combined with other reagents, they activate the contaminating properties of an alchemical mudsnout mixture.

faq.q: Where do these scales come from?
faq.answer: Daggerspine Scales come from Daggerspine naga along the Hillsbrad Foothills coastline directly east of Southshore. Their source includes shorestalkers, shorehunters, screamers, sirens, and their leader, Lady Zephris.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want naga scales?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society wants Daggerspine Scales because their resilient scales have the chemical properties needed to trigger specific infectious agents in experimental blight and disease concoctions.

angles.text: As an Undead, gathering these scales advances the Royal Apothecary Society's research into devastating new plagues against the Forsaken's enemies.
As a member of the Horde, you must navigate carefully along the southern shore, where Daggerspine encampments lie dangerously close to the Alliance port of Southshore.
